basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original children's educational game customer expression-pair sprite. Image 1 is the APPROVED STYLE ONLY: match its thin dark navy outlines, warm storybook colors, softly painted shading, friendly face language, full-body proportions and scale exactly. DO NOT COPY the identities/designs from image 1. Image 2 shows the existing cast: the new character MUST be clearly distinct from EVERYONE there in face, hair silhouette, clothing colors and design. Image 3 is ONLY the thin line weight reference, no robot elements. Output exactly 908x680 landscape with genuine transparent alpha background. Exactly two copies of ONE same new character side by side, each centered in an equal 454px-wide half. Full body, natural relaxed standing pose, body and eyes turned slightly to viewer's RIGHT in BOTH copies. Same scale as approved style; small top margin and complete feet resting on the same baseline at bottom edge without clipping. LEFT face: calm polite slightly sheepish customer asking help with a minor daily inconvenience, closed mouth or very small gentle smile, subtly raised inner eyebrows, never scared/sad/distressed. RIGHT face: warm happy smile, problem solved. CRITICAL clone the exact same pose, hairstyle, head shape, clothing, folds, hands, props, proportions, size, placement relative to half, line weight and shading in both copies: ONLY eyebrows/eyes/mouth expression changes. No text, lettering, numbers, divider, labels, ground shadow or background. Not chibi, not 3D, not thick cartoon outline.
